# CS Foods blocked acquisition evidence

Four ordinary bounded GETs captured a sale catalogue, independently linked corporate operator site, consumer terms, and one linked product. The product returned HTTP 403 CleanTalk. Acquisition stopped at that challenge. No production adapter, runtime source ID, retries, bypass, browser spoofing or database operation is justified.

The corporate site names Chee Song Foods Pte Ltd and links csfoods.sg as Consumer Website. This verifies ownership independently of access; it does not verify historical discounts, campaign dates or physical participation. Catalogue products/sale prices are not complete campaign enumeration.

All raw bodies and metadata are immutable. The original broad accessBlocked field also matched CleanTalk plugin references on accessible catalogue HTML; canonical research interpretation distinguishes the normal 200 catalogue from the actual 403 product challenge. See docs/changes/direct-source-batch-1/research.md and research-ledger.json. Do not overwrite captures.
